plugins.name: shepherd
plugins.description: Sprint-by-sprint version-cycle conductor. Six-agent flock (engineer, critic, coder, auditor, worker, discovery) on a three-section sprint pipeline (INTRODUCTION → BODY → CLOSE). v5.1.1 adds: @discovery sixth lane (read-only orientation), INTRO-COMBO-WAVE pre-MESH parallel batch, hypothesis-driven auditor methodology, sprint-as-patch sizing. v5.1.0 added: flock cohesion substrate, dispatch cascade rule engine, pause-for-dependency primitive. Project-agnostic — branch topology, gates, paths, and ledger discipline configured per-project via .claude/shepherd.toml.
